title: Median household income (2020–2024 five-year ACS estimate, 2024 dollars)
method: Project only the published 2024 ACS five-year B19013 median household income estimate and matching published margin of error by exact Census state FIPS. No calculation, interpolation, or invented confidence interval.
warnings: 2024 ACS five-year estimates represent pooled 2020–2024 responses, not a July 1 or single-calendar-year income measurement.
Margins of error must remain visible in detailed inspection.
Not directly comparable with annual BLS LAUS time periods without explicit method.
